reviews.text: This was our first time at Trophy Pups with Yessenia and Milo was very well taken care of and came home well groomed!!!! We will be going back for sure!
Yessenia took such good care of my long haired miniature dachshund! He came back with a perfect trim, nice & fluffy coat, and smelled amazing 💛 we will definitely be back!

My pup Saul has been going to Jesse at Trophy Paws for several years now - we absolutely love it there!  Jesse is so detailed and takes the most amazing care of Saul.  Saul always has the best cut and groom!  The entire staff at Trophy Paws are amazing - professional, friendly, and always timely.  The bonus after every groom, the seasonal photo shoot that Saul receives.  Highly recommend Jesse and everyone else at Trophy Paws!
Jesse did an amazing job grooming both Poppy and Pancake; he listened to our preferences and gave us exactly what we asked for.

I’ve been here twice and I hate leaving bad reviews but someone has to inform people. Their prices aren’t updated/accurate and when you pick up your dog, your price will be completely different than what you were originally quoted because they always add an extra miscellaneous charge that’s not listed anywhere on their website. In this case, I was charged an extra $30 because my dog is “hyper”?
It’s a joke all around. Was quoted $130-$149. Was charged $210.  Also, they changed my appointment time on the fly.
Thank you for the 5 star Koko & Phoebes Mom! :) Always a pleasure!

Phillip has been to see Adrienne at Trophy Paws twice and has been so well taken care of! She does a great job and is so sweet to him. They even take seasonal photos of him in a Photo Booth, which cracks me up and makes my day. Thank you Adrienne!

(Added Sept 2026) He also has had an amazing experience with Nicole. She is so good with him and didn’t bat an eye when he showed up matted and dirty from a few weeks in the woods. We love Nicole!
everything went smoothly, best cut yet
Been to so many different people to groom my Goldendoodle and finally found “the person”, Jesse. Always does a great job. Kind, professional, and caring.

Kelly at Trophy Paws is absolutely incredible — hands down the best groomer we’ve ever been to. My dog comes home looking flawless every single time, and the care that goes into every appointment is obvious the moment I pick her up. She’s happy, relaxed, and clearly well taken care of, which means everything to me.

And the themed photoshoots? Chef’s kiss. They’re such a fun, thoughtful extra that you just don’t get anywhere else, and they’ve become the highlight of every visit. I genuinely look forward to seeing what Kelly comes up with next.

If you’re on the fence about where to take your dog, stop searching. Kelly and Trophy Paws are the real deal — talented, caring, and worth every penny. Cannot recommend them enough!

Nicole did an amazing job grooming our Siberian husky! She worked so hard on his mats and got his coat completely ready for summer. She kept us updated the whole time, was completely transparent about pricing, and made him so comfortable with regular breaks. She even sent great photos afterward. We are so grateful for her care and communication!
Love how you take care of Snowball. She’s not just an animal she’s family to you guys.

Very unpleasant personal interaction and wholly unprofessional behavior.  I live close by and took my pup here for a walk in nail trim between grooms.  The lady who helped me was kind, and gracious.  Lovely to work with.  She suggested I come back for a groom.  Even though they are close to my home, their hours were not convenient for me.  However, I loved this lady so much.  Personal relationships are very important to me.  I took a few hours off work and booked their first available appointment at 8:30am.  I arrived on time and no one was there.  I rang the doorbell a few times and called several times.  No one answered.  I decided to walk around the block.  Then I text them from the number they used to confirm my appointment.  I didn't hear back, so a few minutes later, I text them to say I could only wait till 9am, because I have to get to the office by a certain time.  They text back, "we are here."  I text, great!  I am walking back.  Mind you this took all of 10 minutes. No big deal.  I walk in and there are 2 gentlemen in the shop and no one speaks.  I say good morning and they respond.  Everything felt off.  Jesse, who was speaking with me at the counter, refused to look at me while I was talking to him.  No one apologized for being late and Jesse presented as annoyed and offended.  I don't know how to explain how "off" the encounter was. I was trying to find my grooming pic to show him what I was looking for and he was rushing me when it took a bit longer for me to find it on my phone.  He asked if it was just a standard puppy cut while I was fumbling.  I don't really know what that means. but I always like to show a photo to make sure we are on the same page.  When I showed him the photo , he said yeah so standard puppy cut in a kinda snarky way.  When I was trying give him details like no fragrance please or what have you, he was just disengaged and still refusing to look at me.  At the end he said they would reach out to me 30 min before the end of his groom.  I said thanks and left.  However, I felt really uncomfortable.  Jesse made it very clear he was annoyed with me and had a dislike or disdain for me.  I just didn't want him to take that out on my dog.  As a black woman, I am always aware that the way people feel about me might affect the way they treat my pup.  I couldn't shake the discomfort, so I went back for my pup.  Maybe another 10 minutes had passed, if that.  I let him know I was uncomfortable with leaving my pup with him because of the way he treated me.  He said I would have to pay for half the service.  I said that was fine.  As I am gathering up my dog and putting him in his carrier, Jesse berated me for being entitled.  He questioned why it took me so long to come back if I was so worried.  I told him it bothered me all the way home. I live just down the street.  He mocked me saying oh you live down the street, but your going to be late for work.  I didn't understand that because I don't work from home.  I was so confused at this point .  I said I work in the loop.  Then he called me a cheapie and told me good luck finding a groomer.  He walked over to me, rather aggressivly, leaned over me to open the door and ushered me out. Needless to say the personal attack, insinuating I was lying about needing to go to work and name calling, reinforced my opinion that he had a personal distaste for me.  I don't trust angry people with my pup.

Jesse is absolutely fantastic . My pup Rush ( a Shih-Tzu mix), has very sensitive skin and allergies but Jesse is incredibly gentle and takes care of him . He also gives me some advice on how to treat his allergies ( only if I ask) .
Rush comes home looking clean , happy and stress-free .
Jesse is been Rush groomer for the last few years. If you want a caring skilled groomer who handles sensitive dogs with love , ask for Jesse he is amazing!!!!

Nicole did an amazing job grooming Henry! She was so kind and patient with him, and he was completely comfortable with her. He looks fantastic, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. I highly recommend Nicole and will definitely be using her for Henry’s grooming every month going forward!

We’ve had a great experience with Yessenia! Our dog is shy and can be anxious, but she is always patient and gentle with him. She takes the time to make him feel comfortable, which really helps. We appreciate the care she gives him and are very happy with the way she grooms him. We’re glad we found someone we trust with our pup! The photos at the end of each grooming is a plus!

Cassidy had her first grooming appointment at Trophy Paws today and we could not be happier with the results. Marco did an amazing job in giving her the perfect Brittany cut. Her last cut (at another business) had been uneven and left her with areas that were overly dense, long and raggedy. She emerged from Trophy Paws with a sleek, soft coat, evenly trimmed to be much less dense but also not overly short. Her nails are smooth, her ears clean, and she smells wonderful without being too perfumey. It's clear that Trophy Paws knows what they are doing and manages their business with care and precision. 😀🐾🐾🛁
Thank you so much for the 5 stars for Trophy Paws! ⭐️ We truly appreciate your support!
Thank you for the 5-star review!  We appreciate you choosing Trophy Paws for Dippers grooming!
We appreciate the 5 stars! ⭐️ Thank you for trusting us with your furry family member, Gigi!

We’ve had trouble finding a groomer for our Samoyed, and struggled with incomplete or botched grooming sessions.

We decided to give Trophy Paws a try, and we couldn’t have been happier. They knew her breed and the challenges with her coat, and they were upfront about the work and pricing it would take to get her coat to where it needed to be.

Nicole in particular was amazing. She texted us during the process and kept us informed in how our Samoyed was doing. She went way over a standard grooming time (in a good way) and put an amazing effort into taking care of our dog. Needless to say, we’re excited we found Nicole and Trophy Paws and look forward to having them as our new regular groomer!
Nicole & Trophy Paws were great!

We have been bringing our dog since he was a little puppy and cannot imagine taking him anywhere else. Even when we have moved multiple times further away, we continue to make the trip across the city for Trophy Paws. They always do an excellent job taking care of our pup and he always comes home looking great. The team genuinely care for him. We have recommended Trophy Paws to several friends and will continue to do so. We couldn’t be happier and will be customers for a long time.

Yessenia has been our Groomer for our Yorkie & Poodle for many years now and she’s truly the best. We will follow her to the ends of the earth! My dogs are my children and I know they are in good hands when they’re with Yessenia.
She’s always down to try out fun haircuts on our pups (ie a mullet for the yorkie, pompom booties for the poodle) and they always leave happy and smelling sooOoOoo good.
I highly recommend Yessenia for your fur babies!
Always very professional and my sweet angel “Piper” comes home looking so good.

Jesse is absolutely the best! My Golden Retriever, Jessie, is a bit of an anxious girl, especially when it comes to baths and grooming, so finding someone she feels comfortable with was incredibly important to me. From the very beginning, Jesse has been so patient, kind, and gentle with her, and it makes all the difference.

Every time I pick Jessie up, she looks absolutely beautiful, smells amazing, and, most importantly, she seems calm and happy. It’s obvious that Jesse genuinely cares about the dogs he works with and goes above and beyond to make them feel safe and comfortable throughout the entire grooming process.

Knowing Jessie is so well taken care of gives me complete peace of mind. I truly couldn’t ask for a better groomer, and I recommend Jesse to anyone looking for someone who treats your dog like family. Thank you for taking such amazing care of my sweet girl!

I bring my 9 year old domestic longhair cat to get groomed by Jesse twice a year. He does an amazing job clipping his nails, getting him handsome, and we always get the funniest/cutest themed pictures. I’ve known Trophy Paws from my days as a dog walker, back in 2021. They were always so kind and friendly to the dogs under my care that I knew I’d use them if I ever had a pet. Now my kitty has a salon to go to too!

We love it here! Our boy, Griffey, is a golden retriever and came out looking beautiful! Most importantly, he seemed to have a wonderful time. The staff seems to truly care about the animals and ensures they feel safe and happy.

Trophy paws is amazing!! They have groomed our little mini labradoodle for a while and she always comes home happy and looking absolutely spectacular. Yesterday we took in our gentle german shepherd for a de-shed, bath and nail trim. She isn’t the easiest of dogs but they were incredibly kind, gentle and she came home a different dog. I cannot believe how good the de-shed treatment was and she’s so cute and fluffy!
They take amazing care of the dogs. No cages, they free roam. Never had a bad experience. I love the photos they send !!

Couldn’t say enough great things about taking my 4 month old puppy to Trophy Paws specifically, Nicole! They took care my of pup Duncan for his first grooming experiance, super kind & friendly. They are the best.

Luis did
a beautiful job on my Milo, he couldn’t be happier. Very precise work and took such good care of my good boy.

I had the best experience with Nicole what a wonderful, patient young woman. She is very patient as well as pleasant smiles every chance she gets. She took good care of my baby boy. Her amazing skills and gentle ways with cutting a nervous big dog, who hates everything that makes noice. I picked him up from Nicole and his hair cut looked amazing. Thank you, for your dedication to a very scared dog Nicole. I will definitely be recommending Nicole to all my friends. My baby boy loved her will be seeing you soon Nicole.

Thank you for a wonderful experience!

Trophy Paws gets 5 stars. 6 if I could! I typically go with Skye but when she’s not available I take another groomer. She groomed my pittie Ali, my husky Sam, and my golden doodle. Their coats are always shiny and smelling good, my doodles haircut is done professionally, exactly the way I want it, every time. They always remind me to book in advance because keeping up with all 3 pups is difficult for me. It’s a drive for me but it’s worth it! Thank you Trophy Paws.
10/10 Definitely recommend Jesse, He Does an amazing job, love his work! Will leave your dog smelling so good!!🤩
I love this grooming store jesse has groomed my dog before and does an excellent job i definitely recommend I just love his work

Hi , Nicole is always happy to see our pup and our pup is equally if not more excited to see her ! she patient,kind and always has a smile on her face ! Thanks Nicole and Ttophy paws for always giving our fur baby a great comfortable experience!

They take my dog here and have been for the past few months. We love them and they love my puppers so much. Always guaranteed a beautiful outcome and I couldn't be happier. My pup always comes out looking her best self and im so grateful. The groomer Nicole is our furrr-vorite lol and we are always delighted when we get her. I have so many great things to say we can't get enough of them. If you want the best groom and experience I would choose them every time.
Nicole doesn’t excellent job. I also got a Christmas card with a photo in it of my pet. I definitely will be returning as it is very welcoming. My dog Sasha was very happy

They are a revolving door of groomers bc nobody can stand their policies. Owner is combative and argues with customers over their experience. We didn’t like our grooming or the company’s policies. Save yourself the anguish and look elsewhere.

We brought our dog here 4-5 times for grooming with three different groomers. She always looked great after appointments. However, our mini Aussie doodle can be quite anxious during grooming, which added an unexpected extra handling fee along with other fees due to her coat length. We have asked if she tried to bite or what exactly she was doing, but they didn’t give us specifics. They do not crate dogs while waiting and we have tried to bring her in for earlier appointments but that doesn’t seem to change the environment. We have reached out to management with questions regarding the fees and their justifications didn’t sit right with us. I do not believe we will be bringing her back at this point.
Love this place. Nice staff. It’s hard to schedule ahead so I appreciate how they are able to squeeze me into their schedules. I also always look foward to the photo they send at the end. Here’s Po !
I found Trophy Paws after my dog Phoebe had a bad experience at another local groomer.  Jesse always does such a wonderful job with Phoebe's haircut and is so patient with her fear of the dryers!
Jesse is amazing, he always gets Wrigley looking super handsome!
Jessie is incredible at what he does always keeps my wife and I up to date and sends us pictures of our special guy. Can’t recommend this company enough
Bozley loves 🏆 🐾 🐾!!!

Nicole does a fantastic job!! Lenny is eager to go there and is always the happiest boy when I pick him up. Very friendly and clean atmosphere with great employees! The photos are the best cherry on top

We take our small dog to Trophy Paws and have had full service grooms (bath, brush, and cut) by several of the groomers - most recently, Jesse took care of her. Our dog always looks great, and we’ve found she is much less anxious at Trophy Paws than other groomers. Although our dog can be anxious around other dogs, we trust Trophy Paws to be patient with her and give her the space she needs. I’d definitely recommend Trophy Paws.

We had an amazing experience at Trophy Paws. Theresa made my girlie look, smell, and feel so fresh! Usually aura is timid with new people, but she warmed up really nicely because of Theresa’s easy-going and gentle demeanor. Theresa listened to my requests for Aura’s appt and was fully present as I was speaking with her. She really takes the time to make sure your dog is comfortable and well taken care of. The post bath picture was the best part of my day and the summertime bandana and adorable little purple flower to match Aura’s collar were so generous and cute! Definitely going back to Theresa and Trophy Paws! 🥰
